### Aptar Increases Quarterly Dividend to $0.50 Per Share


October 29, 2026


CRYSTAL LAKE, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


AptarGroup, Inc. (NYSE: ATR), a global leader in drug delivery, dosing and protection technologies, and consumer product dispensing, today announced that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.50 per share, an increase of approximately 4% from the previous quarterly dividend of $0.48 per share. The payment date is December 3, 2026, to stockholders of record as of November 12, 2026.


“Increasing our dividend to $0.50 per share puts Aptar on track for its 33rd consecutive year of paying an annually increasing dividend and reflects our confidence in the Company’s future growth,” said Gael Touya, President and Chief Executive Officer. “As we invest in the business to drive profitable growth, we remain focused on disciplined capital allocation and creating sustainable, long-term value for our shareholders.”


**About Aptar**


Aptar is a global leader in drug delivery, dosing and protection technologies, and consumer product dispensing. Aptar partners with the world’s top healthcare and consumer brands to deliver medicines and create exceptional user experiences. Serving diverse markets, from pharmaceutical to beauty to food and beverage, Aptar combines market expertise with proprietary design, engineering and science to develop innovative solutions that help improve lives worldwide. Headquartered in Crystal Lake, Illinois, Aptar employs 14,000 dedicated people across 20 countries. Learn more at[http://www.aptar.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.aptar.com&esheet=54631223&newsitemid=20261029593243&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.aptar.com&index=1&md5=4da3a0f3dcf12ac00638f2c40d7b413c) .
